text: Verdict arithmetic: sign test on 21 discordant rows (P(X>=17)=0.003599), margin 130>=54, flips 100<=162, kill ~0.999. The verdict is carried by A-B=13 and W/L=17/4.
Corpus geometry drives the margin: 34/54 none rows make the first-alternative baseline structurally 0/34 there (15/20 on mode rows), so B=15 is a floor any none-shaped gain clears.
A=28 = 12 none-row recognitions + 16 mode-row rights; W=17 = those 12 plus 5 tie-break-beating mode wins (f020-007,011,016,027,042); L=4 (f020-008,010,029,050).

Error structure: 22/34 none rows still got a mode suggestion; misses cluster sk-design 9/9, cli-external 7/11, mcp-tooling 3/9, sk-doc 3/5. none-pick precision 12/12 but recall 35%; 19 of 26 wrong picks unanimous across rotations (17 none rows, 2 mode rows).

The four L rows follow one shape: surface noun in the prompt draws the surface mode while the label follows the requested action (OpenCode->sk-code-opencode vs sk-code-quality at 0.81-0.85 confidence; Webflow vs sk-code-quality; README vs sk-create-skill).
Pick probabilities carry no separating signal: mean modal prob 0.678 on none wins vs 0.688 on none misses; 0.797 on mode rights vs 0.823 on mode wrongs.
10 of 54 rows split 2-1 across the 3 cyclic orders, 8 of them dissenting exactly on the order-1 rotation; F=10 is the sum of these dissents (positional sensitivity, not sampling noise).
Transport was clean: 163 measured calls (162 choices + 1 auth), no timeouts, wall sum 54.1s, mean 332ms, p50 328ms, p95 380ms, est 19446 input tokens.
The first-alternative baseline is the routers' tieBreak declaration order, not a decision, in both the cli-external and sk-doc routers.
On the same labels a degenerate policy outscores Jev: always-none is right 34/54 (63%) vs Jev 28/54; the keep rule only compares against the 15/54 tie-break baseline.

The fixture is not census output (source 'fixture-047' is never emitted) and its tie premise reproduces as a clarify action only for the 12 sk-doc rows; replaying all 54 through the scorer's runCensus on a tree byte-identical to the measurement commit gives 12 clarify + 42 route. Committed-corpus census still reproduces (clarify 3).

For the 42 route rows the engine takes the explicit-multi-mode branch: both named modes hit explicit alias detectors and are returned as an orderedBundle with equal scores before the ambiguity test runs.
